r = Readiness::Round.new("/home/user/workspace/repo/bench/upstream/readiness/round-app-suites.yml", work: "/tmp/ptest/apps")
r.m["rails"]["candidate"] = "1e235cee11b0a7aecb189d8837534807626287aa"
r.rails
Readiness::Services.up(%w[postgres redis], r.work)
r.m["suites"]["campfire"] = {
  "repo" => "https://github.com/basecamp/once-campfire",
  "ref" => "a05ee908977d8ec97bfce0503c8e689334804d08",
  "framework" => "minitest", "env" => { "RAILS_ENV" => "test", "PARALLEL_WORKERS" => "1" },
  "setup" => ["bin/rails db:prepare"], "test" => "bin/rails test"
}
names = ARGV.empty? ? %w[writebook lobsters-rspec-rails-main mastodon redmine] : ARGV
names.each do |name|
  cfg = r.m["suites"].fetch(name)
  cfg.delete("share_base")
  cfg["ruby"] = "4.0.9"
  cfg["shims"] = [*cfg.fetch("shims", []), "printf '4.0.9\\n' > .ruby-version"]
  cfg["rails"] = nil if name == "writebook"
  cfg["setup"] = ["bin/rails db:prepare"] if name == "writebook"
  if name == "mastodon"
    cfg["shims"] = ["printf '4.0.9\\n' > .ruby-version"]
    cfg["setup"] = ["bin/rails db:create db:schema:load"]
  end
  s = r.suite(name)
  %w[base cand].each { |t| puts [name, t, s.prepare(t)].inspect }
end

require "fileutils"
require "json"
apps = "/tmp/ptest/apps"
%w[lobsters-rspec-rails-main mastodon redmine campfire writebook].each do |app|
  %w[base cand].each do |side|
    source = "#{apps}/suites/#{app}/#{side}"
    next unless File.exist?("#{source}/Gemfile.eco-#{side}.lock")
    %w[a b].each do |replica|
      dest = "/tmp/ptest/measure/#{app}-#{side}-#{replica}"
      FileUtils.mkdir_p(dest)
      FileUtils.ln_sf(source, "#{dest}/app")
      bumps = case app
      when "lobsters-rspec-rails-main" then {"rspec-rails"=>{git:"https://github.com/rspec/rspec-rails",ref:"9fb6f4f0a3"}}
      when "mastodon" then {"rspec-rails"=>{git:"https://github.com/rspec/rspec-rails",ref:"570b2b0a79"}}
      when "writebook" then {"globalid"=>"1.4.0"}
      else {}
      end
      File.write("#{dest}/Gemfile", <<~RUBY)
        ENV["ECO_RAILS"] = #{"#{apps}/rails-#{side}".inspect}
        ENV["ECO_GEMFILE"] = #{"#{source}/Gemfile".inspect}
        ENV["ECO_BUMPS"] = #{bumps.inspect.inspect}
        eval_gemfile #{"#{source}/Gemfile.eco-#{side}".inspect}
      RUBY
      FileUtils.cp("#{source}/Gemfile.eco-#{side}.lock", "#{dest}/Gemfile.lock")
    end
  end
end

require "json"
require "minitest"
require "active_support"

ActiveSupport.on_load(:active_record) do
  ActiveSupport::Notifications.subscribe("sql.active_record") do |event|
    sql = event.payload[:sql]
    Thread.current[:ptest_sql]&.push(sql) if sql.match?(/\A(?:BEGIN|ROLLBACK|COMMIT|SAVEPOINT|RELEASE)/)
  end
end

Minitest::Test.prepend(Module.new do
  def run
    Thread.current[:ptest_sql] = []
    result = super
    File.open(ENV.fetch("PTEST_OUTCOMES"), "a") do |file|
      file.puts JSON.generate([self.class.name, name, result.assertions,
        result.failures.map { [_1.class.name, _1.message] }, Thread.current[:ptest_sql]])
    end
    result
  ensure
    Thread.current[:ptest_sql] = nil
  end
end)

require "/tmp/ptest/apps/suites/campfire/cand/test/test_helper"
require "json"
require "stringio"

class PTestFailureProbe < ActiveSupport::TestCase
  def test_dirty_failure
    rooms(:watercooler).update_column(:name, "ptest dirty")
    assert_equal "expected", "actual", "ptest deliberate failure"
  end

  def test_clean_after_failure
    assert_not_equal "ptest dirty", rooms(:watercooler).reload.name
  end
end

reporter = Rails::TestUnitReporter.new(StringIO.new, {})
reporter.start
rows = %w[test_dirty_failure test_clean_after_failure].map do |name|
  result = PTestFailureProbe.new(name).run
  reporter.record(result)
  [name, result.assertions, result.failures.map { [_1.class.name, _1.message] }]
end
puts JSON.generate(rows: rows, output: reporter.io.string)
STDOUT.flush

searches.title: Add four notes to the Rails 8.2 upgrade guide
Skip the HTML entity gsub! in JSON::Coder output with nothing to escape
Load author addresses with authors in FieldOrderedValuesTest
Fix belongs_to `touch` option incorrectly triggering on models with composite primary keys
Fix flaky `ChainedAliasAssociationsTest`
Fix preload for scoped has_one associations with LIMIT
Return falsy from save when before_commit rolls back
Pass enums added to a parent down to existing subclasses
Don't build an asynchronous queries session until it's needed
Fix #58736: make Action View template compilation Ractor-local
Decode and encode PostgreSQL integer arrays in C: 3 objects at any length, 2.3x to 12x faster
Preserve SQLite3 column `rowid` and generated type in the schema cache
Load relations returned by `connected_to_many`
Fix truncation and disabling referential integrity with same-named tables across different schemas
Log at info in the test environment of new apps
Stop discarding all pools in TestUnconnectedAdapter
Don't reuse connection pool for SQLite `:memory:` databases
Add the `identity: true` column option to the PostgreSQL adapter
Avoid pair arrays when generating error translations
Avoid copying nested Symbol attribute keys
Use symbol name for known symbols
Allow named variants to evaluate dynamic transformation options
Share a collection buffer only between ERB templates
Disable triggers of tables shadowed on the PostgreSQL search path
Truncate tables shadowed on the PostgreSQL search path
